position.name: Automation Engineer (gn) Industrial Robotics & Software Development

jobDescription.name: Your mission
jobDescription.value:
At Wandelbots, we combine modern software development with industrial robotics and automation. With NOVA, we are building a platform that makes the use of industrial robots easier, more flexible, and more software-driven. As an Automation Engineer, you will work right at this intersection: You will commission automation systems and robots, support our teams with your hands-on industrial expertise, and implement customer-specific solutions based on NOVA. You will support projects from technical concept and implementation through to commissioning at the customer site, while bringing insights from real-world automation projects back into our product and engineering teams.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

Industrial Robotics & Automation 
You will be responsible for the setup, commissioning, and operation of internal and customer automation systems. Your responsibilities will include:

  • Configuring, parameterizing, and commissioning industrial robots from different manufacturers on our shop floor and at customer sites 
  • Integrating robots, PLCs, and other peripheral devices into an automation environment 
  • Supporting electrical commissioning, troubleshooting, maintenance, and on-site customer deployments 
  • Acting as a technical point of contact for robotics and industrial automation across our teams 
  • Bringing practical experience from customer projects into technical and product related decisions 

NOVA & Software Development 
You will use Wandelbots NOVA to implement customer-specific robotics and automation solutions and bring an important application perspective into our product development. Your responsibilities will include:

  • Translating customer robotics requirements into NOVA-based software solutions 
  • Developing project-specific applications, workflows, and functionality using Python 
  • Combining and applying existing NOVA capabilities to real industrial use cases 
  • Working closely with Software, Product, and Robotics Engineering on new use cases and technical challenges
  • Providing structured feedback from real-world projects and turning project learnings into reusable solutions and best practices

jobDescription.name: Your profile
jobDescription.value:
You have hands-on experience in industrial robotics and automation and enjoy working at the intersection of automation and software. Ideally, you bring: 

  • Strong knowledge of industrial robot programming, parameterization, and commissioning 
  • Practical experience with at least one major robot manufacturer such as KUKA, ABB, Yaskawa, FANUC, or Stäubli 
  • Experience with industrial automation systems and customer-site commissioning
  • Basic knowledge of PLC programming and electrical commissioning 
  • Good knowledge of Python 
  • A basic understanding of software architecture and modern development practices 
  • Ideally, a qualification as a certified electrical specialist / qualified electrician or a comparable qualification
  • A hands-on, solution-oriented mindset and openness to modern development and AI assisted tools 

What else is important
  • German language skills at B2 level or above 
  • English language skills at B2 level or above 
  • Willingness to regularly work on-site at customer locations and support commissioning activities 
  • Enjoyment of working across different teams, including Software Development, Robotics, Product, and Customer Projects 

Your Profile Is Particularly Interesting to Us If … 
  • You have worked with several different robot manufacturers 
  • You have supported complete automation systems from planning through to commissioning 
  • You are equally interested in traditional automation and software development 
  • You have experience with industrial communication systems and interfaces 
  • You enjoy working directly with customers, software developers, and automation specialists 
  • You want to do more than just experiment with new technologies and are motivated to bring them into real production environments 

Why This Role? 

This role combines two areas that are increasingly converging in industrial automation: robotics and software development. You will work with real industrial robots and automation systems while also developing NOVA-based solutions for concrete customer applications. This gives you the opportunity to bring the perspective of an industrial user directly into our software and product development. In doing so, you will help us ensure that NOVA is not only technologically powerful, but also consistently aligned with the needs of real-world industrial automation projects.

jobDescription.name: Why us?
jobDescription.value:
Make an impact!
Work on an innovative, deep tech product that adds value to the robotics world and to society! Become a crucial part of something new, big and exciting where you can truly make an impact!

Our teams inspire!
Cross-functional communication is key. You'll get to know many of your 100+ colleagues. Collaborate with great people on our international teams who value knowledge sharing and unique ways of doing things!

Be authentic!
Work in a value-driven environment where everything may not be perfect, but we're working on it! Your feedback is required while you receive feedback and appreciation for your work!

position.name: Senior Software Engineer (gn) Camera Integration Framework

jobDescription.name: Your mission
jobDescription.value:
At Wandelbots, we are transforming the way people interact with robots. We are building the robotics platform that combines traditional manufacturing with modern software engineering - enabling developers to build robotics applications using modern software engineering principles on top of a reliable robotics core. Cameras are becoming a core part of this platform. From vision-guided robotics to AI-driven applications, the ability to manipulate the physical world depends on sensing the physical world first.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will build the foundation for integrating cameras into our cloud-native platform. Instead of developing one-off integrations, you will design and implement a scalable integration framework that enables both Wandelbots engineers and camera manufacturers to integrate new devices with minimal effort.

Together with other Wandelbots engineers, you will define the architecture, build the first production-ready camera drivers yourself, and create the SDK and interfaces that make future integrations repeatable. Working closely with infrastructure & robotics engineers, product teams, and hardware partners, you will shape how vision devices become a substantial part of the Wandelbots ecosystem. The camera integration framework will become a component of the Wandelbots platform, running inside our Kubernetes infrastructure alongside the rest of our robotics stack.

jobDescription.name: Your profile
jobDescription.value:
This role sits at the intersection of cloud infrastructure, backend engineering, and industrial vision. We don't expect anyone to be an expert in every area. Instead, we're looking for someone with a strong engineering foundation, who has previously designed APIs and has deep expertise in at least one of the following domains:
Industrial Vision & Camera Integration: You have integrated industrial cameras into production systems and understand how they are used in automation projects.
Camera Development: You have worked for a camera manufacturer or built camera software, SDKs, or device interfaces.
Cloud-native Hardware Platforms: You have experience building Kubernetes-based systems that discover, manage, and control hardware devices, including custom resources and Kubernetes controllers.

Further required Skills:
Several years of experience building backend systems (e.g. Python, Go)
API design and versioning
Comfortable developing containerized software and familiar with Kubernetes-based deployments.
Ability to take ownership of architecture, make technical decisions, and drive projects from concept to production

Awesome if you have:

Strong experience extending Kubernetes using Custom Resources, Operators, or Controllers.
Experience with Kubernetes networking for hardware and network-attached devices.
Experience integrating vendor SDKs behind a common abstraction layer.
Experience with Linux device management and exposing hardware into containers
Experience with industrial cameras, media pipelines, or camera protocols
Understanding of computer vision concepts such as calibration, depth imaging, and point clouds.
Experience with video streaming and media handling.
Background in robotics or industrial automation.

What we care about:

We are looking for an engineer who enjoys building platforms rather than one-off integrations. You should be comfortable navigating ambiguity, making architectural decisions, and creating systems that others can successfully build upon.
This is an opportunity to build the foundation for every camera integration at Wandelbots. You won't just implement the first integrations - you'll define the architecture, SDK, and developer experience that camera manufacturers, partners, and internal teams will use for years to come.
